plan_validity.instructions: Is the proposed Batch2 P42-181 assertion-level partial transfer plan valid as defined? Only valid_as_defined passes.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The proposed assertion-level partial transfer is valid as defined: it transfers only P42-181 empty-state message/status ownership for the named stable row, while retaining the mixed production/mobile/SVG/interaction remainder and unchanged A/E/M. Only this label passes.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete contradiction exists between the partial-transfer plan, immutable P42 assertions, current inventory/ownership, OpenSpec R20d, or agreed boundaries.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A necessary prerequisite for this bounded plan is missing, such as exact assertion mapping, test contract, or removal gate.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan cannot be assessed due to missing facts about current source/ownership; do not choose just because the future Browser Mode test is not yet implemented.
criteria.implementation_issue: Current source/props make the exact proposed empty-status contract impossible or misleading in the proposed component mount.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposal claims to migrate the whole stable row or mobile case, changes A/E/M, drops retained P42 assertions, modifies GitHub Actions, or treats the 33 Phase5 IDs as final.
criteria.other: A different concrete plan blocker is supported by the evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence does not establish validity or a concrete blocker.

case_finding.instructions: What concrete plan defect, if any, is supported by the facts? Consider support-series props when judging the empty-state fixture.

criteria.no_case_specific_finding: No material plan defect; bounded assertion transfer may proceed under stated gates.
criteria.baseline_id_mapping: Inventory omission of P42-181 or the proposed corrected row mapping conflicts with immutable baseline accounting.
criteria.empty_status_contract: All hidden expense keys do not guarantee the status appears when a support series is present/visible; fixture requirements are incomplete.
criteria.partial_transfer_boundary: Plan improperly claims whole stable scenario/E2E migration or fails to retain the mixed route/SVG/recovery remainder.
criteria.duplicate_or_wrong_owner: An existing unit test or P42-517 already owns the exact empty status contract, so this would duplicate/wrongly assign ownership.
criteria.openspec_semantics: R20d message/status and recovery/no-bars semantics cannot be clarified as planned without changing the actual requirement.
criteria.map_signal_overreach: Low-confidence raw MAP result is used as blanket approval of the mixed scenario instead of evaluating only P42-181.
criteria.migration_count_error: M/A/E or stable row count is changed despite assertion-level partial transfer.
criteria.user_boundary_violation: The plan conflicts with no GitHub Actions or Phase5 deferral.
criteria.other_concrete_finding: Another specific issue is shown by evidence.
